name: Cultural Triangle & Ancient Kingdoms
description: A private journey through rock fortresses, sacred caves and ancient capitals, with time for village cooking and lakeside evenings. Fully customisable. Final dates, accommodation and inclusions require a personalised quote.

itinerary.description: Arrive at the airport and settle into Negombo. Enjoy a relaxed lagoon-side evening.
Travel to Sigiriya with an afternoon at leisure after the drive.
Climb Sigiriya early, followed by a hosted village lunch and a Sri Lankan cooking session.
Explore the ancient city at your own pace with a local guide; return to Sigiriya.
Visit Dambulla cave temples en route to Kandy. Take a gentle lakeside walk.
Visit the Temple of the Tooth and Peradeniya Botanical Gardens.
Return to the airport with departure timing planned around the drive.

name: Tea Trails & Ella Highlands
description: Cool mornings, tea country and unhurried hill walks: a scenic escape designed for travellers who love landscapes and local flavours. Fully customisable. Final dates, accommodation and inclusions require a personalised quote.

itinerary.description: Airport welcome and private transfer to Kandy; relax after your journey.
Visit a working tea estate on the drive into the hills, with a tasting and overnight in Nuwara Eliya.
Enjoy a relaxed day among gardens and tea country, with an optional guided countryside walk.
Take the scenic train from Nanu Oya to Ella, subject to availability; private road transfer is the alternative.
Walk to Little Adam’s Peak and visit Nine Arch Bridge; allow time for a café lunch.
Return by road to Colombo with comfort stops and an overnight city stay.
Enjoy a relaxed breakfast before your airport transfer.

name: Southern Shores & Galle Escape
description: A laid-back coastal break pairing Galle’s historic lanes with ocean views, a cooking experience and plenty of time to do very little. Fully customisable. Final dates, accommodation and inclusions require a personalised quote.

itinerary.description: Meet your driver at the airport and travel to Galle; settle into your coastal stay.
Take a guided Galle Fort walk, explore independent cafés and enjoy sunset on the ramparts.
Continue along the coast to Mirissa, stopping for a local lunch and beach time.
Enjoy a free beach day with an optional beginner surf lesson in Weligama, subject to conditions.
Join a Sri Lankan cooking experience, followed by a free afternoon by the sea.
Return to the airport by private vehicle, allowing sufficient time for your flight.

name: Wild South: Safari & Seaside
description: From Ella’s green hills to a Yala jeep safari and the southern coast, this nature-focused journey balances early adventures with quiet afternoons. Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed. Fully customisable. Final dates, accommodation and inclusions require a personalised quote.

itinerary.description: Airport welcome and an overnight in Colombo to rest before the journey inland.
Travel into the highlands by road, with scenic stops and an overnight in Ella.
Visit Nine Arch Bridge and take an optional guided hill walk matched to your fitness.
Travel south to Tissamaharama and relax before the early safari start.
Take one guided jeep safari in an open Yala sector, subject to park access; spend the afternoon at leisure.
Travel to Tangalle for coastal scenery and a relaxed afternoon.
Explore Galle Fort with a local guide and stay overnight on the coast.
Private airport transfer with departure time matched to your flight.

name: Sri Lanka Signature: Island in Slow Motion
description: Our complete first-time journey: ancient heritage, tea-covered hills, an Ella escape and a gentle south-coast finish, with private transfers and room to linger. Fully customisable. Final dates, accommodation and inclusions require a personalised quote.

itinerary.description: Arrive and unwind in Negombo after your private airport transfer.
Travel to Sigiriya and enjoy a quiet afternoon at your hotel.
Explore Sigiriya rock fortress early and share a village-style lunch.
Visit Dambulla cave temples on the way to Kandy; evening lakeside stroll.
Discover the Temple of the Tooth and Peradeniya Botanical Gardens.
Drive through tea country, stopping at a tea estate for a tasting.
Scenic Nanu Oya–Ella train journey if available, with road transfer as an alternative.
Explore Nine Arch Bridge and Little Adam’s Peak, or choose a leisurely café afternoon.
Travel to the south coast with comfort stops; settle in near Galle.
Enjoy a guided Galle Fort walk and an afternoon by the ocean.
A free coastal day; optional cooking class or beginner surf lesson can be arranged.
Depart with a private airport transfer timed to your flight.
